create_direct_estimator: create a Direct estimator instance with a MuJoCo model and configuration length for trajectory optimization
run_optimize: run the optimize method on a Direct estimator to perform trajectory optimization
test_status: test the status method on a Direct estimator to retrieve optimization iteration and convergence details
review_cost: review the cost method on a Direct estimator to retrieve total, sensor, force, parameter costs and optional gradients and Hessians
summarize_settings: summarize the settings method on a Direct estimator to configure estimation horizon, iteration limits, tolerances, and flags
